instruction: How to add a fq_codel qdisc with memory limit
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root fq_codel memory_limit 16mb

instruction: How to add a fq_codel with quantum
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root fq_codel quantum 1514

instruction: How to set flows count in fq_codel
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root fq_codel flows 4096

instruction: How to set ecn threshold in fq_codel
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root fq_codel ecn

instruction: How to disable ECN in fq_codel
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root fq_codel noecn

instruction: How to set codel target for fq_codel
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root fq_codel target 10ms

instruction: How to set codel interval for fq_codel
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root fq_codel interval 200ms

instruction: How to set ce_threshold in fq_codel
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root fq_codel ce_threshold 8ms

instruction: How to set drop_batch size in fq_codel
output: tc qdisc change dev eth0 root fq_codel drop_batch 64

instruction: How to add a cake qdisc with bandwidth
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit

instruction: How to set cake shaper for best effort
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 100mbit besteffort

instruction: How to set cake to diffserv4
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit diffserv4

instruction: How to set cake to wash
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit wash

instruction: How to set cake to ack-filter
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit ack-filter

instruction: How to set cake to split-gso
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake split-gso

instruction: How to set cake with ingress mode
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit ingress

instruction: How to add cake qdisc with NAT
output: tc qdisc add dev eth0 root cake bandwidth 10mbit nat

instruction: How to list tc qdiscs with details
output: tc -d qdisc show

instruction: How to show tc class statistics with rate
output: tc -s -d class show dev eth0

instruction: How to show tc filter with verbose output
output: tc -s filter show dev eth0

instruction: How to show tc monitor for netlink events
output: tc monitor

instruction: How to show tc qdisc statistics in JSON
output: tc -j -s qdisc show dev eth0

instruction: How to show tc class in JSON format
output: tc -j -s class show dev eth0

instruction: How to show tc filter in JSON format
output: tc -j -s filter show dev eth0

instruction: How to use tc with stateless offloads
output: ethtool -K eth0 hw-tc-offload on && tc qdisc add dev eth0 root handle 1: htb default 30 && tc filter add dev eth0 parent 1: protocol ip flower skip_sw src_ip 10.0.0.1 action drop
